 Kishan, Iyer hit 50s
 Sun, 01 November 2026 
 Share: 
 14:20 
 Naman Dhir and Nitish Kumar Reddy put on a 46-run partnership off 30 balls 
 Ind 191-8 (20 ovs) vs NZ | Scorecard 
 Ishan Kishan and skipper Shreyas Iyer struck explosive half-centuries, but New Zealand pacers, led by Adam Milne's 4/19, fought back to restrict India to 191 for eight in the fifth and final T20I in Hamilton on Sunday. 
 Milne dismissed Abhishek Sharma (1) and Sanju Samson (4) in successive overs during the powerplay before Kishan (61 off 32 balls; 5x4, 5x6) and Iyer (50 off 23 balls; 3x4, 4x6) consolidated India's innings with an entertaining 93-run stand off just 43 balls. 
 Nathan Smith (2/38 in three overs) and Blair Tickner (2/38) then derailed India's recovery in the middle overs. 
 Arshdeep is the new man in and he takes a single as India put on 191 for 8 on the board. 
 Prince Yadav is the new man in and he gets a single off  a leg bye. 
 Bhuvi then gets a four as he flicks the low full toss to fine leg boundary. 
 Bhuvi is out next ball caught in the deep for 6. 
 Milne comes on to bowl the last over and Bhuvi starts the over with a single to point. 
 Reddy is out next ball as he miscues the flick and is caught in the deep for 22. 
 Bhuvneshwar is the new man in and he is off the mark with a single. 
 Nitish then slashes at the ball as four runs come off the last ball of the 19th. A wicket and 12 runs come off it. 
 Tickner is back in the attack and the ball falls short of the incoming fielder at long on and Reddy takes gets a single. 
 Low full toss and Dhir just helps it on it's way over deep fine leg for a six! 
 Slower ball next and Dhir looks to go big but miscues is caught nicely by Bracewell running back at extra cover and Dhir is out for 32 off 23.
